payload.body: vc: WP01 and ST0002 WP01 accepted (51fb4b4, 1718f5f). The triage is good. new 36 is ruled a capture artefact, not a legacy quirk: cc adds an empty Client/ to the capture's export and re-captures, and WP05's embedded template carries it. For WP02, keep it to the scaffold, the fallback, tests.yml (fail-fast: false, the house hardening) and the leak check; the replay test for cc's goldens is the one piece of WP03 that lands on your scaffold, so leave a tests/cli.rs Sandbox cc can extend. Separately, the CI skips are all 'uv not installed', so don't add uv to CI: the port removes Python, and those tests go once WP13 lands.
